About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading digital payments and financial services company. With 350M+ users and 30M+ merchants, we are building the financial super app for India — payments, banking, insurance, wealth, and commerce on one platform.

Role: Business Development Manager — Merchant Partnerships (2-5 years)

You will own merchant partnerships for Paytm's offline payments business across a defined geography. You'll sign enterprise merchants, negotiate commercial terms, and drive GMV growth through strategic accounts.

What You'll Do
- Own a portfolio of 50-100 key merchant accounts across retail, hospitality, and QSR categories
- Drive new merchant acquisition: prospecting, pitching, negotiating, and closing enterprise deals
- Negotiate commercial terms including MDR, exclusivity, and co-marketing commitments
- Build relationships with merchant CEOs, CFOs, and payment heads
- Work with product team to feed merchant requirements into payment product roadmap
- Track GMV, transaction volume, and merchant NPS for your portfolio
- Coordinate with operations team for onboarding, device deployment, and issue resolution

What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years BD, partnerships, or B2B sales experience
- Strong negotiation skills — you can anchor a deal and find creative win-wins
- Ability to build C-suite relationships and maintain them over time
- Financial modeling skills — can build ROI cases and defend commercial proposals
- Self-starter who can manage a complex pipeline without hand-holding
- Willingness to travel extensively within your territory

Bonus Points
- Prior experience in payments, POS, or fintech distribution
- Network in retail, QSR, or hospitality sectors
- MBA from a top-tier institution
- CRM experience (Salesforce, HubSpot)

About Ola
Ola is India's ride-hailing leader, now pivoting to become a global EV company with Ola Electric. Our strategy and operations team is the connective tissue between leadership vision and on-ground execution.

Role: Associate — Strategy & Operations (1-4 years)

This is a high-visibility generalist role at Ola. You will work directly with business heads and the founding team on our most critical strategic priorities — from EV supply chain to driver economics to city expansion.

What You'll Do
- Work on ambiguous, high-stakes strategic problems: market entry, pricing strategy, competitive response, org design
- Build data-backed analyses and financial models to support decisions
- Own project management for cross-functional initiatives end-to-end
- Prepare board-level materials and leadership presentations
- Conduct market research and competitive intelligence
- Drive operational excellence in specific business units through process design
- Manage stakeholders across business, product, finance, and operations

What We're Looking For
- 1-4 years experience in management consulting, investment banking, or strategy at a startup
- Strong problem structuring — can take an ambiguous problem and break it into first principles
- Advanced Excel and basic SQL skills for analysis
- Exceptional written communication — can write executive memos that are crisp and persuasive
- Comfort with ambiguity and ability to drive clarity through structured thinking
- High ownership — you drive projects to completion, not just contribute to them

Bonus Points
- Prior consulting experience (MBB, Big 4 strategy)
- Experience in mobility, logistics, or EV ecosystem
- MBA from a top-tier institution
- Financial modeling experience (three-statement models, DCF)

About Juspay
Juspay processes $40B+ in annual payments and serves India's top enterprises. The CoS role is for someone who wants to accelerate their career by operating at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution at the highest level of the company.

Role: Chief of Staff to the CEO (2-5 years)

You will be an extension of the CEO — attending all key meetings, driving accountability on top priorities, and handling projects that fall outside normal business units. This is a 18-24 month role with a defined exit into a P&L leadership position.

What You'll Do
- Attend all leadership team meetings, capture decisions, and drive follow-through
- Own the CEO's priority stack — ensure top 5 company priorities have clear owners and timelines
- Prepare board meeting materials, investor updates, and all-hands presentations
- Lead special projects assigned by CEO: acquisitions diligence, new geography entry, org design
- Manage OKR process for the company — quarterly planning, mid-quarter reviews
- Act as CEO proxy in cross-functional meetings when CEO is not available
- Conduct market research and build analyses to inform strategic decisions

What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years experience in consulting, banking, VC, or strategy roles
- Exceptional executive communication — written and verbal
- Strong analytical skills — comfortable with financial models, market sizing, data
- High discretion and judgment — you will handle confidential information daily
- Ability to influence without authority — you must drive accountability across all functions
- Extremely organized, detail-oriented, and reliable

Bonus Points
- Prior CoS experience or equivalent EA/COS internship
- Startup or operator experience (not just advisory)
- MBA from a top institution
- Experience with board governance and investor relations

About CRED
CRED is known for building the most beautiful consumer fintech products in India. Design at CRED is not a support function — it is a core strategic lever. Our designers have creative control and product influence that is rare in Indian tech.

Role: Product Designer (3-6 years)

You will design end-to-end product experiences for CRED's financial lifestyle products — from blank canvas to shipped pixel. You'll own your product area creatively, collaborating with PMs and engineers as an equal, not a executor.

What You'll Do
- Own end-to-end design for a product area: research, information architecture, interaction design, visual polish
- Build high-fidelity Figma prototypes that engineers can implement precisely
- Contribute to and enforce CRED's design system — every component you build should be reusable
- Run lightweight user research: usability testing, card sorting, jobs-to-be-done interviews
- Collaborate with motion designers to define micro-interactions and transitions
- Present design work to leadership and synthesize feedback into iterations
- Mentor junior designers and raise the creative bar on the team

What We're Looking For
- 3-6 years product design experience with a portfolio that demonstrates range and depth
- Master-level Figma skills — your files are clean, componentized, and handing-off-ready
- Strong visual design fundamentals: typography, color, spacing, hierarchy
- Clear interaction design thinking — you can explain why every transition and state exists
- Familiarity with design systems and component architecture
- Portfolio that shows both craft-level UI and thoughtful UX reasoning

Bonus Points
- Motion design and After Effects / Principle experience
- Prior fintech or premium consumer app experience
- iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design depth
- Experience building accessible designs (WCAG compliance)

About Flipkart
Flipkart serves 400M+ registered customers across Bharat. Our UX Research team ensures that the product decisions made in Bengaluru reflect the reality of users in Bhopal, Bhavnagar, and beyond — a crucial mission in India's diverse market.

Role: Senior UX Researcher (3-6 years)

You will be the voice of Flipkart's user in product decisions, conducting research that shapes roadmaps and challenges assumptions. You will own research for one product area (e.g., Search, or Fashion, or Grocery) and be a strategic partner to PMs and designers.

What You'll Do
- Plan and execute end-to-end research studies: usability tests, generative research, diary studies, surveys
- Conduct field research in Tier 2-3 cities to understand Bharat users' context and behaviors
- Build and maintain a research insights repository accessible to all product teams
- Translate research insights into actionable product recommendations
- Design and analyze surveys for quantitative research at scale (10K+ respondents)
- Collaborate with data science team to combine qualitative insights with behavioral data
- Champion research-driven culture — present findings to senior leadership and product reviews

What We're Looking For
- 3-6 years UX research experience with a mixed-methods toolkit
- Strong qualitative research skills: moderation, interviews, contextual inquiry, thematic analysis
- Survey design and quantitative analysis experience
- Ability to communicate research findings in ways that drive product decisions, not just inform
- Comfort working in ambiguous environments — can scope and execute research with limited guidance
- Hindi/regional language skills a strong advantage for Bharat research

Bonus Points
- Field research experience in rural or semi-urban India
- Eye tracking or biometric research experience
- Academic background in HCI, psychology, anthropology, or cognitive science
- SQL skills for behavioral data analysis

About PhonePe
PhonePe processes 5B+ transactions annually. Our data science team builds the models that power credit scoring, fraud detection, merchant intelligence, and personalization across our 500M+ user base.

Role: Data Scientist — Lending (2-5 years)

You will build credit scoring and affordability models for PhonePe's lending products — buy now pay later, personal loans, and merchant credit. Your models determine whether millions of Indians get access to credit, so precision and fairness are equally important.

What You'll Do
- Build credit scorecards using logistic regression, gradient boosting, and neural networks
- Engineer features from transactional data, behavioral signals, and bureau data
- Design and analyze champion-challenger experiments for model improvements
- Work with product and risk teams to define acceptable NPAs and approval rates
- Monitor model drift and build automated retraining pipelines
- Conduct fairness analysis — ensure models don't discriminate across demographics
- Present model results and business impact to senior leadership

What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years data science experience in production model development
- Strong statistics fundamentals: hypothesis testing, regression, classification, probability
- Proficiency in Python (scikit-learn, XGBoost, pandas)
- Strong SQL for feature extraction and analysis
- Experience with A/B testing and causal inference for model evaluation
- Understanding of credit risk metrics: Gini, KS statistic, PSI, NPA rates
- Ability to communicate model decisions to non-technical stakeholders

Bonus Points
- Prior credit risk or BFSI experience
- Bureau data integration experience (CIBIL, Experian)
- Causal ML experience (uplift modeling, propensity scoring)
- Published research or Kaggle competition wins

About Meesho
Meesho's data team is the backbone of every product and business decision. With 150M+ users and massive transaction volume, we have one of the richest commerce datasets in India. Our analysts translate this data into product and business insights.

Role: Business Analyst (0-2 years)

You will support product, marketing, and operations teams with data analysis, dashboards, and experiment analysis. This is an analyst role — you'll be deep in SQL and spreadsheets — but you'll also be expected to have strong business opinions, not just produce reports.

What You'll Do
- Write and optimize complex SQL queries across large datasets (billions of rows)
- Build dashboards in Tableau or Looker for product and leadership teams
- Analyze A/B experiment results and communicate findings with statistical rigor
- Conduct funnel analysis, cohort studies, and retention analysis for product teams
- Build ad hoc analyses to answer business questions as they arise
- Document analysis methodology and maintain a team analysis repository
- Present findings to senior stakeholders with clear recommendations

What We're Looking For
- 0-2 years experience as a data analyst, business analyst, or in a similar role
- Strong SQL proficiency — complex joins, window functions, CTEs are table stakes
- Excel/Google Sheets proficiency for ad hoc work
- Basic statistics: mean, median, variance, statistical significance
- Clear communication — can turn data into a story and a recommendation
- Business curiosity — you ask 'so what?' about data, not just 'what is it?'

Bonus Points
- Python for data analysis (pandas, matplotlib)
- Tableau or Looker dashboard building experience
- E-commerce or marketplace domain understanding
- Prior internship in analytics at a tech company

About Zomato
Zomato delivers food from 300,000+ restaurants across 800+ cities. Our operations team ensures that every delivery happens in time, every restaurant partner is enabled, and every rupee is spent efficiently.

Role: City Operations Manager (2-5 years)

You will own all operations for Zomato's business in a specific city — delivery executive management, restaurant onboarding, logistics optimization, and customer experience. You are the CEO of your city.

What You'll Do
- Own P&L and operational KPIs for your city: delivery time, order defects, DE utilization, CAC
- Manage a team of ops executives and delivery supervisor leads
- Optimize delivery routes and fleet allocation during peak hours
- Lead restaurant partner onboarding and menu quality initiatives
- Resolve escalated customer complaints and build systems to prevent recurrence
- Analyze city-level data to identify opportunities and diagnose problems
- Collaborate with product, marketing, and finance teams on city-specific initiatives

What We're Looking For
- 2-5 years operations experience, preferably in logistics, food tech, or retail
- Proven track record managing on-ground operations teams
- Strong data analysis skills — can pull SQL queries and build Excel models
- Process design mindset — can identify inefficiencies and build SOPs
- Comfort with ambiguity and ability to make decisions with incomplete information
- Willingness to work non-standard hours during peak periods (weekends, festivals)

Bonus Points
- Prior food tech, quick commerce, or hyperlocal delivery experience
- Six Sigma or Lean certification
- P&L ownership experience
- Proficiency in local language of assigned city

About Microsoft
Microsoft Azure is the world's second-largest cloud platform, serving millions of enterprise customers. Our program management team coordinates complex, multi-team initiatives that span engineering, sales, and operations.

Role: Senior Program Manager — Azure Commercial (4-7 years)

You will program manage Azure's commercial expansion initiatives — coordinating across 10+ engineering teams, regional sales teams, and partner organizations to deliver large-scale programs on time and within budget.

What You'll Do
- Own end-to-end program management for cross-functional Azure commercial initiatives
- Build and maintain program plans, risk registers, and dependency maps
- Lead weekly cross-team reviews and escalate blockers to leadership
- Define program success metrics and track progress against them
- Facilitate decision-making when teams disagree and timelines conflict
- Build communication plans for internal stakeholders and external partners
- Conduct retrospectives and institutionalize learnings across programs

What We're Looking For
- 4-7 years program or project management experience at a tech company
- Demonstrated ability to manage programs with 50+ cross-functional stakeholders
- Strong communication and facilitation skills — can run effective exec-level reviews
- Risk management mindset — identifies and mitigates issues before they become crises
- Experience with Agile and waterfall methodologies
- Ability to build influence and drive accountability without direct authority

Bonus Points
- PMP or PgMP certification
- Azure or cloud platform experience
- Change management experience (Prosci ADKAR or similar)
- Engineering background helpful for technical program management
